source_span.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-proper-smooth-family-curves (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4496-4502

the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: descend to finite type: write S = Spec(A) as a limit of finite type Z-subalgebras, descend f to a finitely presented f_i over S_i, improve it to smooth proper of relative dimension 1, and cut out an open U_i over which the fibres are geometrically connected, replacing X -> S so the Noetherian hypotheses hold; split S by invertibility of l; case (a) l invertible shows the sheaves are finite locally constant via proper base change stalks, finiteness, specialization isomorphisms and the locally constant characterization; case (b) l = p uses that stalks are finite and vanish in degree >= 2, computes f_* of the constant sheaf, and reads R^1 off the Artin-Schreyer sequence as an extension between the cokernel and kernel of Frobenius-minus-one on vector bundles, concluding by the Frobenius-linear constructibility lemma (source lines 4504-4580)
